<thought>To locate the template that reproduces the Still‑Gennari HWE transformation, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break a phosphonate ester and form an alkene and a carboxylic ester, matching the described forward reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["phosphonate_ester"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene", "carboxylic_ester"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
